The launcher no longer crashes at start when your user folder or the game folder has letters outside your Windows language (for example a Cyrillic "Documents" folder on an English Windows). Settings, saves and logs are found again in those folders, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
"Update now" also works when the game is installed in a folder with such a name on Windows.
"Update now" now works for the Linux .tar.xz download too (it already did for the AppImage). Installs from 1.2.0 or older need this one update downloaded by hand.
In the Carter boss fight, the new renderer draws the helicopter again; after a long session it could go invisible.
The Grenade Launcher, the dual pistols and other shiny weapons and surfaces no longer draw flat white in the new renderer.
